metadata.title: FFT AI Edition – RTT Engine Prompts
metadata.description: Prompt sets for RTT engines lumen.rtt1.online, hephaestus.rtt2.online, aurion.rtt3.online, harmonia.rtt12.online.

engines.description: Lumen engine for RTT Tier 1 clarity and coherence tasks.
prompts: Evaluate clarity of the provided signal under RTT1 declared coherence.
Identify drift boundaries and return bounded/unbounded classification.
Summarize structural coherence in one canonical sentence.

engines.description: Hephaestus engine for RTT Tier 2 structural synthesis.
prompts: Synthesize a structural representation of the signal using RTT2 operators.
Map paradox interactions and classify structural vs incidental.
Generate a coherence-preserving transformation of the input.

engines.description: Aurion engine for RTT Tier 3 conceptual field modeling.
prompts: Construct a conceptual field representation of the signal.
Evaluate resonance-time alignment across multiple structural layers.

engines.description: Harmonia engine for RTT Tier 12 harmonic synthesis and multi-domain coherence.
prompts: Generate harmonic coherence mapping across all RTT regimes.
Evaluate paradox harmonics and produce a stability envelope.
